(opposed to अदस्, e.g. अयं लोकः or इदं विश्वम् or इदं सर्वम्, this earthly world, this universe; अयम् अग्निः, this fire which burns on the earth; but असाव् अग्निः, that fire in the sky, i.e. the lightning: so also इदम् or इयम् alone sometimes signifies ‘this earth’; इमे स्मः, here we are.) इदम् often refers to something immediately following, whereas एतद् points to what precedes (e.g. श्रुत्वैतद् इदम् ऊचुः, having heard that they said this). इदम् occurs connected with यद्, तद्, एतद्, किम्, and a personal pronoun, partly to point out anything more distinctly and emphatically, partly pleonastically (e.g. तद् इदं वाक्यम्, this speech here following ; सो ऽयं विदूषकः, this Vidūṣaka here).

spans.s: , Ved. now, at this moment
(often connected with a gen. of अहन्, e.g. इदा॑ चिद् अ॑ह्नः, or अह्न इदा, this present day, ‘nowadays’; and with ह्यस्, e.g. इदा ह्यः, only yesterday), RV.
beginning now or with this moment.
इ-दा—वत्सर॑ m. (originally perhaps) ‘the present or current year’
one of the names given to the single years of a period of five years

one of the five years in which gifts of clothes and food are productive of great rewards, AV.; VS.; MaitrS. &c. (इदावत्सरीय, mfn. belonging to such a year Comm. on Pāṇ. इदु-वत्सर and इद्-वत्सर = इदा-वत्सर above, इद्-वत्सरीय = इदावत्सरीय above.)
mfn., belonging to such a year as इदावत्सर, Comm. on Pāṇ. इदु-वत्सर and इद्-वत्सर = इदा-वत्सर above, इद्-वत्सरीय = इदावत्सरीय above.
a measure of time (the fifteenth part of an Etarhi), ŚBr. xii, 3, 2, 5.

now, at this moment, in this case, just, even (with gen. of अहन्, e.g. इदानीम् अह्नः, this present day, ‘nowadays’; इदानीम् एव, just now; immediately; इदानीम् अपि, in this case too; तत इदानीम्, thereupon, then), RV.; ŚBr.; Ait.; Ragh.
(in rare cases it is an expletive, affecting but slightly the sense).
mf(ई)n. present, modern, momentary, of the present moment, Sāh.
